technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (Hull flip, volume spike, force index cross) show strength, but price remains below intermediate moving averages and Ichimoku cloud with negative CMF, limiting conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CPT shows no fundamental momentum across all smart money indicators with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, and earnings volatility risk in 2 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (30/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no clear conviction signal.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 306+, falling USD) combined with critical earnings binary event in 2 days creates severe risk environment for real estate sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip, 15x volume spike, and force index cross-up signal short-term momentum reversal with price near support (97.85) in extreme fear environment (30/100 fear-greed).
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 2 days, price below all intermediate moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, negative CMF/AO, macro crisis (VIX 306+, inverted yield curve), and zero fundamental/smart money conviction create unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Hull flip and 15x volume spike show short-term momentum reversal at support in extreme fear environment, but earnings binary in 2 days combined with price below all intermediate moving averages and zero fundamental conviction make risk-reward unacceptable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 2 days creates binary event risk that could gap through support (97.85) and invalidate technical setup; macro crisis (VIX 306+, inverted yield curve) amplifies real estate sector downside.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical shows moderate momentum but fundamental, risk, and debate agents all heavily weight earnings binary and macro stress as disqualifying factors
decision.portfolio_note: Already 7 positions in Real Estate sector; adding CPT increases concentration risk in unfavourable macro environment without fundamental justification.
